=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3829-3830, 3840 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The jq output serializes `.head_branch`, and GitHub often returns null or an empty string for it on workflow_dispatch runs. The bash check `[ "${CLEANUP_DISPATCH_RUN_BRANCH:-}" = "${BRANCH}" ]` then fails on the string "null".
  WHY: Valid orphan workflow_dispatch review runs on the target branch stay active because cleanup filters them out.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3829-3830, 3840 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The loop requires `CLEANUP_DISPATCH_RUN_BRANCH == BRANCH`, so runs with a null or empty `head_branch` are discarded. scripts/gh_helpers.sh:2265-2268 accepts null or empty `head_branch` for dispatch runs (issue #6629, Q2 / #4928).
  WHY: The cancel POST is never issued and the step logs a false "No active" message, which is the failure mode the cancel block exists to prevent (Phase 3c dispatch run 43300092840 sat queued 48 minutes after PR #9416 closed).
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3821 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The comment cites "CLAUDE.md §14" but §14 is Consumer Repo Registry; the batching rule is §15 (GitHub API Call Hygiene).
  WHY: There is no runtime impact, but the cross-reference is misleading.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3820-3821 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The comment cites the wrong section for the one-API-call rule. §14 covers the consumer repo registry and GitHub API call hygiene is §15.
  WHY: No runtime behavior fails. The citation misdirects maintainers.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3830, 3840 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The listing serializes `head_branch` and the loop requires it to equal `BRANCH`, so a matching active workflow_dispatch run with a null or empty `head_branch` is discarded. scripts/gh_helpers.sh:2265-2268 (`select(.event == "workflow_dispatch" and (((.head_branch // "") == "") or .head_branch == $branch))`, citing #4928 and #6629) accepts that shape. jq interpolates null as the literal string "null".
  WHY: Cleanup skips such a run and prints "No active dispatch review runs", leaving it queued and holding `review-gate-notice-<repo>-<pr>`. The server-side `branch=` filter already narrows the listing, so the jq re-check only discards the null case.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3821 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The comment cites "CLAUDE.md §14" (Consumer Repo Registry, CLAUDE.md line 424), but the API call hygiene rule is §15 (CLAUDE.md line 439).
  WHY: No runtime failure; the cross-reference sends readers to the wrong section.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
